cases.name: an unsatisfiable script
cases.purpose: unsat, with the names of the assertions in the core.

input.smtlib:
(set-option :produce-unsat-cores true)
(declare-const x Int)
(assert (! (> x 0) :named a))
(assert (! (< x 0) :named b))
(assert (! (> x 5) :named c))
(check-sat)
(get-unsat-core)

cases.name: a satisfiable script
cases.purpose: sat, with a model on request.

cases.name: a counter loop's invariant
cases.purpose: Spacer (set-logic HORN) on x := 0; while x < 10: x := x + 1, with the property x <= 10: sat, and the model defines the invariant inv (plan change CX7, the recipe findInvariant).

input.smtlib:
(set-logic HORN)
(declare-fun inv (Int) Bool)
(assert (forall ((s0 Int)) (=> (= s0 0) (inv s0))))
(assert (forall ((s0 Int) (t0 Int)) (=> (and (inv s0) (and (< s0 10) (= t0 (+ s0 1)))) (inv t0))))
(assert (forall ((s0 Int)) (=> (and (inv s0) (not (<= s0 10))) false)))
(check-sat)

cases.name: a small MaxSMT optimum
cases.purpose: Optimize with soft constraints: three bits, no two neighbours both set, as many set as possible; one soft constraint is missed. The engine of the recipe findOptimum (plan change CX7), which writes maximize or minimize.

input.smtlib:
(declare-const a Bool)
(declare-const b Bool)
(declare-const c Bool)
(assert (not (and a b)))
(assert (not (and b c)))
(assert-soft a :weight 1 :id missed)
(assert-soft b :weight 1 :id missed)
(assert-soft c :weight 1 :id missed)
(check-sat)
(get-objectives)
